title: Geology near a hazardous waste landfill at the headwaters of Lake Marion, Sumter County, South Carolina
citation: Prowell, D.C., 1990, Geology near a hazardous waste landfill at the headwaters of Lake Marion, Sumter County, South Carolina: U.S. Geological Survey Open-File Report OF-90-236, map scale 1:24,000.
notes: Plates 1-2 (pages 1-2) are OCR of geologic sections and show only unit names and the lithology legend; no depths could be read from them. Page 4 is absent from the packet. Figures 1-4 (pages 27-30) have only labels. Depths for MAN-1A come from the text. Black Creek Group lower/middle/upper units are informal subdivisions of this report; their ages: lower and middle units together 'middle to late Campanian'. The report uses 'Peedee formation' (lowercase) for local beds equivalent to the Peedee Formation. Sawdust Landing age is the author's 'most likely' bracketed age. References: skipped North Carolina and Georgia-only entries (Brett and Wheeler 1961; Buie 1978, 1980; Heron and Wheeler 1964; Sohl and Christopher 1983; Stephenson 1907, 1912, 1923, 1927; Wolfe 1976) and an unpublished permit application. No groundwater values (aquifer properties are left to a later report).
